correctness.rationale: The polynomial identities are exactly verified modulo three. They give a flat weighted complete intersection with smooth generic Auer–Top quartic and two smooth geometric conic components. Four transverse nodes exhaust the intersection scheme; an étale coordinate change gives uv=t² at each. Frobenius interchanges the components, fixes each node and acts by -I on rank-three graph homology, identifying the quadratic norm-one torus. Resolving four A1 total-space singularities gives K2,4; the exact reduced Laplacian has Smith diagonal (1,1,2,2,8), proving the geometric Néron group. The verifier was executed successfully.
